value.rationale: Complete exact finite dynamical classification of a canonical highly symmetric cubic bipartite incidence graph, with all 262144 labelled initial states, orbit counts, basin sizes and entry-time layers. The 92 phase symbols and 2/4/130 fibers encode all 4186 oscillation basins; notably every orbit admits a transient ancestor and settling time sharply differs from the closely related Fano/Heawood case. This is a natural exact network invariant, not an arbitrary slice or routine duplication of an existing graph table.
